title: FastGHA: Generalized Few-Shot 3D Gaussian Head Avatars
summary: FastGHA is a feed-forward method that reconstructs high-fidelity 3D head avatars from sparse images in under one second. It uses transformer-based feature fusion and pre-trained priors to enable real-time animation and precise expression control for unseen identities.
research_notes: Officially presented at ICLR 2026. Leverages DINOv3 and Stable Diffusion VAE features for enhanced structural and textural fidelity.

evolution.summary: FastGHA represents a shift from slow subject-specific optimization to generalized, feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction. It follows the earlier Avat3r (2025) and is now integrated with newer Disney projects like RelightAnyone and CANRIG for advanced environmental lighting and rigging.
